summary: School district expresses concern about preserving E-Rate funding to maintain connectivity and IT support for students and staff.

claims.argument: Without core funding, schools would face increased IT burdens and connectivity issues.
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, if we were to lose this funding, it may mean that we would have less IT people to manage any connectivity issues and if a computer is in need of repair that may keep a student from having one for the amount of time said repair takes.
